subject.title: fix(usage): show provider quota in usage footer

question: Should per-response `/usage` footers perform a bounded provider-usage lookup during reply delivery after the auth-profile scoping bug is fixed, or should quota text only come from cached/preloaded provider usage state?
rationale: The implementation is narrow, but adding provider/auth probing to the reply-delivery path is a latency and product tradeoff that automation should not decide for maintainers.

options.title: Fix Auth Scoping And Accept Bounded Lookup
options.body: Repair the agentDir-scoped auth-profile path, keep the 2500 ms omit-on-timeout behavior, and proceed if focused tests and CI stay green.

options.title: Require Cached Quota State
options.body: Ask the PR to source quota text from warmed or cached provider usage snapshots instead of probing during final reply delivery.

options.title: Keep Quota In Status Only
options.body: Reject inline provider quota footers for now and keep `/status` plus status-style surfaces as the supported provider quota display.

recommendation.title: Fix Auth Scoping And Accept Bounded Lookup
recommendation.body: Repair the agentDir-scoped auth-profile path, keep the 2500 ms omit-on-timeout behavior, and proceed if focused tests and CI stay green.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points most strongly to steipete for provider-usage/status ownership and the reply-delivery latency tradeoff.
